title: Some binary pulsars allow tests of general relativity.
purpose: Highlight their use as natural laboratories.
narration: Binary pulsars serve as cosmic laboratories for testing general relativity under extreme conditions. Scientists use their stable radio pulses to measure effects like gravitational waves and time dilation. These systems provide some of the strictest tests of Einstein's theory, confirming predictions with remarkable accuracy.
